parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is one of the toggle switches of the electrical wall switch, made of durable polycarbonate plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It functions as the main actuator to open or close the electrical circuit, controlling the connected device or light.
parts.Movement_description: It pivots or rocks back and forth around a hinge mechanism to switch between ON and OFF positions.

parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the second toggle switch of the electrical wall switch, also made of polycarbonate plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as an independent actuator to control another circuit or device, similar to the first switch.
parts.Movement_description: It rocks or pivots around its hinge to alternate between ON and OFF states.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body or mounting plate of the electrical wall switch, made of ABS plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support for the switches and houses the internal wiring and electrical contacts.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and fixed to the wall, serving as the stable foundation for the switch assembly.
